semiconductor_relevance: High — Tendly Enterprises Co., Ltd. provides critical automation equipment components and motion control systems for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Tendly Enterprises Co., Ltd. specializes in automation equipment components and motion control system software, catering to the semiconductor industry. They offer products from leading brands and their own brand, NuAES, including servo drives, motors, motion controllers, and industrial robots. Their solutions are designed to enhance automation and process control in semiconductor manufacturing.
